name: RackDroid Drums
author: RackDroid
description: Classic analog drum voices in the 808 tradition, made for RackDroid

modules.name: BD-808
modules.description: Bass drum voice: sine with pitch sweep, click and saturation

modules.name: SD-808
modules.description: Snare drum voice: two detuned partials plus snappy noise

modules.name: HH-808
modules.description: Hi-hat voice: six-oscillator metallic bank, closed chokes open

modules.name: CP-808
modules.description: Handclap voice: retriggered noise bursts with reverb tail

modules.name: CB-808
modules.description: Cowbell voice: two square partials through a band filter

modules.name: TM-808
modules.description: Tom voice: tunable from low tom to conga

modules.name: BD-909
modules.description: Bass drum voice: fast deep sweep, hard click and drive

modules.name: SD-909
modules.description: Snare drum voice: short shell, tone-controlled bright crack

modules.name: HH-909
modules.description: Hi-hat voice: bright six-oscillator bank with sizzle, closed chokes open

modules.name: BD-606
modules.description: Bass drum voice: small, tight and boxy

modules.name: HH-606
modules.description: Hi-hat voice: thin fizzy four-oscillator bank, closed chokes open

modules.name: SD-707
modules.description: Snare drum voice: mid-forward body with a hard noise burst

modules.name: CB-707
modules.description: Cowbell voice: brighter pair, faster decay

modules.name: TM-505
modules.description: Tom voice: plastic swept body, tunable high
